acceptance: The owner has decided: either a ruleset or branch protection on main requires the SkillSpector job (and the existing template gate), or the decision not to is recorded here.
context:
Owner action. An agent must not change repository settings without that decision.


[owner decisions 2026-11-13, second round] Owner chose: add a ruleset on main requiring 'Template gate and wrapper cycle' and 'SkillSpector static scan', after PR #118 merges; admin bypass stays available to the owner.


[closeout] Owner chose a ruleset. Created repository ruleset 27237239 'main: required checks' (active, default branch): requires 'Template gate and wrapper cycle' and 'SkillSpector static scan' from GitHub Actions (app 15368); repository admins may bypass. `gh api repos/joeharris76/skill-sync-skills/rules/branches/main` lists both checks.
description: main has no branch protection or rulesets, so the SkillSpector CI job reports a failure but cannot block a merge. Making it a required status check is a repository-settings change only the owner can authorize.
